reviews.name: Marcus Whitfield
reviews.comment: Drove off the lot in a '68 Fastback and could not be happier. The sales team knew every detail on the car and did not push me into anything I did not want.

reviews.name: Janelle Rivera
reviews.comment: Great financing experience. The rate I got was better than my credit union, and paperwork only took about thirty minutes. Would buy from Charge again.

reviews.name: Theo Nakamura
reviews.comment: Traded in my daily driver and got more than KBB was showing. Honest numbers and no funny business. Highly recommend the trade-in department.

reviews.name: Priya Desai
reviews.comment: Service department caught a brake issue during my free inspection that I had no idea about. They fixed it same day for a fair price.

reviews.name: Wesley Brooks
reviews.comment: Nice selection of muscle cars, but the test drive I scheduled online was not actually booked when I got there. Still ended up having a good visit.

reviews.name: Amelia Foster
reviews.comment: First time buying a classic car and the team walked me through everything. The warranty they offered made me feel a lot more comfortable pulling the trigger.

reviews.name: Daniel O'Connor
reviews.comment: Bought my Shelby here three years ago and still bring it in for service. The same mechanic has worked on it every time, which I really appreciate.

reviews.name: Sofia Martinez
reviews.comment: The showroom is spotless and they actually let you sit in the cars without hovering. Bought a Bronco and the whole thing took under two hours.

reviews.name: Grant Holloway
reviews.comment: Took a while to get a callback after my online inquiry, but once I got through to someone they were helpful. Ended up finding what I wanted elsewhere.

reviews.name: Evelyn Park
reviews.comment: Financing was easy, the warranty covered an alternator issue at month four, and the loaner car was nicer than my actual car. Really great dealer experience.
